about_the_game:
Ocean of Vengeance is a 2D pirate adventure game where you sail across multiple ocean environments, explore islands, and engage in naval combat.

Exploration and Navigation

Navigate your ship through interconnected ocean zones using the minimap system. A lot of different islands are scattered across the waters, each offering unique interactions and challenges. You can dock at islands to participate in activities or simply explore the coastlines.

Combat System

The game features turn-based naval combat against a lot of different types of enemy ships. Each enemy has distinct stats and behaviors, culminating in boss encounters that test your tactical skills. Combat rewards include gold and materials for ship upgrades.

Island Activities

Islands host various mini-games, including dice-based challenges where you face off against NPCs in games of chance and skill. Winning these encounters earns you crew members and resources. Each island has its own personality and gameplay mechanics.
